notes: The comb heads READ the phase; they do not create it. R(k) computed from the WEIGHTS ALONE is a perfect period-3 comb, and deleting P's period-3 band (7 of 513 bins) collapses every comb to 3.4% of amplitude while an energy-matched band leaves them at 99.8%.
This intervention has no comb self-overlap artefact, no selection effect, and no perturbation/phase entanglement -- the three things that made the attention-roll design uninterpretable.
MLM health is gated: an arm that lost the behaviour is not interpreted (R13).
